name: CAPE
fullName: HTB Certified Active Directory Pentesting Expert

cost.note: Exam voucher. Requires 100% completion of the matching Academy job-role path, which needs a subscription.

prerequisites: Full completion of the matching HTB Academy job-role path
levelNote: Score weights the required training as well as the exam: the Active Directory Penetration Tester path is rated Hard by HTB Academy, 15 modules. Exam-only score 78, +4 for the training. level measures the depth a credential demands, not only how the exam checks it.

name: COAE

levelNote: AI security is roughly three years old as a discipline and its credentials have not yet accumulated the depth of the established expert-tier certs.
